title: What Everybody Wants
coreMove: Before pressing your request, name out loud the worry, fatigue, or wish the other person is carrying, and wait for them to confirm it before you continue

exampleSpecs.domain: a charge nurse asking a burned-out night-shift colleague to cover one more weekend
exampleSpecs.audience: a charge nurse on a short-staffed cardiac unit
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the colleague agrees willingly or files a grievance the next morning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the charge nurse first says aloud what the colleague is tired of and waits for the small nod before mentioning the schedule

exampleSpecs.domain: a violin teacher rescheduling a recital after a twelve-year-old student freezes in the dress rehearsal
exampleSpecs.audience: a private music teacher with a studio of nine students
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the child quits violin that night or returns the following week
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the teacher names the embarrassment the child is sitting in before suggesting any plan, and lets the child speak first

exampleSpecs.domain: a roofer trying to collect a six-week-overdue payment from an elderly homeowner
exampleSpecs.audience: the owner of a two-truck roofing outfit
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether he gets paid this month or has to write off the job
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the roofer voices the homeowner's fear about her late husband's finances before the invoice is mentioned

exampleSpecs.domain: a stepfather asking his teenage stepdaughter to put her phone away at dinner
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the household survives the meal without another door slammed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he chooses between his prepared sentence about respect and a sentence that names her loneliness, and he picks the second

exampleSpecs.domain: a city bus driver defusing a passenger who is shouting about a missed stop
exampleSpecs.audience: a transit driver on the late-evening route
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the situation ends with an apology or with police called
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the driver names the passenger's worry about being late to a sick relative before answering anything about the route

exampleSpecs.domain: a junior associate persuading a senior partner to reread a brief the partner already signed off on
exampleSpecs.audience: a second-year associate at a mid-size firm
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a citation error reaches the judge or is caught in time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the associate rehearses what the partner is anxious about this week and opens with that, not with the error
